guide.name: Salt Lake City under the Wasatch
guide.description: Seven days of mountain trails, pioneer history, mole and fry sauce, and a day out on the Great Salt Lake, with the Wasatch always in view.

properties.name: Kimpton Hotel Monaco Salt Lake City
properties.notes: A 1924 bank building turned playful hotel, a block from the light rail and the Gateway.
properties.address: 15 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

properties.name: The Grand America Hotel
properties.notes: The splurge. Marble, gardens and a proper afternoon tea, and an easy drive up to the canyons.
properties.address: 555 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

properties.name: Little America Hotel
properties.notes: The Grand America's friendlier sibling across the street, with big rooms and a big pool.
properties.address: 500 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

properties.name: Inn on the Hill
properties.notes: A 1906 mansion turned bed and breakfast below the Capitol, with valley views and a cooked breakfast.
properties.address: 225 N State St, Salt Lake City, UT 84103

properties.name: Red Iguana
properties.notes: Seven kinds of mole and a line out the door since 1985. Ask for the mole sampler.
properties.address: 736 W North Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84116

properties.name: The Copper Onion
properties.notes: Seasonal American cooking downtown. The ricotta dumplings and the burger are the regulars' picks.
properties.address: 111 E Broadway, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

properties.name: Takashi
properties.notes: The city's best-loved sushi bar. No reservations, so come early.
properties.address: 18 W Market St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

properties.name: Lucky 13 Bar and Grill
properties.notes: Huge burgers with house-smoked bacon. Bring an appetite and a 21-plus ID.
properties.address: 135 W 1300 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84115

properties.name: Ruth's Diner
properties.notes: Breakfast in a trolley car up Emigration Canyon. Order the mile-high biscuits.
properties.address: 4160 Emigration Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

properties.name: Caputo's Market & Deli
properties.notes: Italian deli and a famous chocolate room. Grab sandwiches for a picnic.
properties.address: 314 W Broadway, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

properties.name: Feldman's Deli
properties.notes: A New Jersey-style Jewish deli. Pastrami on rye and a black-and-white cookie.
properties.address: 2005 E 2700 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84109

properties.name: Laziz Kitchen
properties.notes: Lebanese small plates and fresh hummus, in the small Central Ninth neighborhood.
properties.address: 912 S Jefferson St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

properties.name: HSL
properties.notes: Thoughtful seasonal dinners in a warm, wood-lined room. Book a table on a weekend.
properties.address: 418 E 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

properties.name: Eva's Bakery
properties.notes: French pastries and good coffee on Main Street. Easy breakfast before Temple Square.
properties.address: 155 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

properties.name: Tulie Bakery
properties.notes: A neighborhood bakery known for its croissants and seasonal fruit tarts.
properties.address: 863 E 700 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84102

properties.name: Publik Coffee Roasters
properties.notes: A big, bright roastery with good toast. A fine place to plan the day.
properties.address: 975 S West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

properties.name: Squatters Pub Brewery
properties.notes: Salt Lake's original brewpub, open since 1989. Try the Emigration Amber.
properties.address: 147 W Broadway, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

properties.name: Beer Bar
properties.notes: Long tables, bratwurst and Belgian frites, with a deep list of local and imported beer.
properties.address: 161 E 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

properties.name: Water Witch
properties.notes: A tiny cocktail bar with no menu. Tell them what you like and they'll make it.
properties.address: 163 W 900 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

properties.name: Temple Square
properties.notes: The heart of the city since 1847. Walk the gardens and hear the Tabernacle organ at noon.
properties.address: 50 N West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84150

properties.name: Beehive House
properties.notes: Brigham Young's 1854 home, with free guided tours of the family rooms.
properties.address: 67 E South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

properties.name: Utah State Capitol
properties.notes: Free tours of a grand 1916 capitol, and a sweeping view of the valley from the steps.
properties.address: 350 State St, Salt Lake City, UT 84103

properties.name: Cathedral of the Madeleine
properties.notes: A 1909 cathedral with painted walls and stained glass. Free choir concerts in season.
properties.address: 331 E South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

properties.name: Natural History Museum of Utah
properties.notes: A wall of dinosaurs and great Native American galleries, in a building set into the foothills.
properties.address: 301 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

properties.name: Utah Museum of Fine Arts
properties.notes: A broad collection on the University of Utah campus, with strong Western American galleries.
properties.address: 410 Campus Center Dr, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

properties.name: The Leonardo
properties.notes: Science, art and tinkering under one roof, in the old city library. Good on a rainy day.
properties.address: 209 E 500 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

properties.name: Clark Planetarium
properties.notes: Free exhibits and a dome theater at the Gateway. The Foucault pendulum is mesmerizing.
properties.address: 110 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

properties.name: Salt Lake City Public Library
properties.notes: A curving glass library with a rooftop garden. Climb the walkway for views of the mountains.
properties.address: 210 E 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

properties.name: Gilgal Sculpture Garden
properties.notes: A strange little garden of stone sculptures, including a sphinx with Joseph Smith's face.
properties.address: 749 E 500 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84102

properties.name: Tracy Aviary
properties.notes: Hundreds of birds inside Liberty Park, from bald eagles to flamingos.
properties.address: 589 E 1300 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84105

properties.name: This Is The Place Heritage Park
properties.notes: A living history village where Brigham Young first saw the valley in 1847.
properties.address: 2601 Sunnyside Ave S, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

properties.name: Utah's Hogle Zoo
properties.notes: A hillside zoo across from the heritage park. Polar bears and a fine African savanna.
properties.address: 2600 Sunnyside Ave S, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

properties.name: Red Butte Garden
properties.notes: Botanic gardens and trails in the foothills, with summer concerts in the amphitheater.
properties.address: 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

properties.name: Liberty Park
properties.notes: The city's big central park, with a pond, paddle boats and a long walking loop.
properties.address: 600 E Harvey Milk Blvd, Salt Lake City, UT 84105

properties.name: Memory Grove Park
properties.notes: A quiet green ravine below the Capitol, leading up into City Creek Canyon.
properties.address: 300 N Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT 84103

properties.name: Ensign Peak Nature Park
properties.notes: A short, steep climb to the best view of the city. Go at sunset.
properties.address: 1002 N Ensign Vista Dr, Salt Lake City, UT 84103

properties.name: Sugar House Park
properties.notes: Rolling lawns and a pond with mountain views. Pair it with lunch in Sugar House.
properties.address: 1300 E 2100 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84106

properties.name: Donut Falls Trailhead
properties.notes: An easy canyon hike to a waterfall that pours through a hole in the rock. Best in summer.
properties.address: Big Cottonwood Canyon Rd, Brighton, UT 84121

properties.name: Antelope Island State Park
properties.notes: A causeway out into the Great Salt Lake, with bison, salt beaches and huge sunsets.
properties.address: 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075
